author_reading.rationale: A clk_a register drives a combinational clk_b gate; the enable has no low-phase latch.

rationale: gate_en is launched by clk_a and directly ANDs asynchronous clk_b. It can change while clk_b is high, creating an extra or truncated clock pulse. No glitch-free gate or safe enable synchronization exists. Missing generated-clock intent is an additional inventory obligation; it does not weaken the concrete gate defect.

The clk_a register directly controls an AND gate on asynchronous clk_b. Enable transitions while clk_b is high can generate runt or extra clock edges; no low-phase latch or glitch-free gate is present.
